releaseNotes: SAM 0.12.26 adds a graphical setup assistant for single-device installation and company-scoped Intune/GPO packages. The assistant verifies the company and token expiry, writes a private deployment package, and can invoke Microsoft Win32 Content Prep Tool to create .intunewin files. Downloads now supports enrollment-token lifetimes of 1 hour to 7 days. Remote assignment remains in the organization Intune/GPO console.
